# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.11

This release introduces RX Softphone 0.5.0 as a native Windows notification-area
application while retaining the authenticated-call stability delivered in
version 0.4.4.

## Windows tray application

- RX Softphone starts directly in the Windows notification area without
  leaving a CMD window open.
- The tray icon and menu report SIP registration, relay connectivity, current
  call state, live connected-call duration, and the last call's number,
  outcome, and duration.
- Operators can open the phone, hang up an active call, temporarily disable or
  enable the phone, and exit cleanly from the tray.
- Managed workstations keep Unpair locked to the RX Tracker Administrator
  workflow. Disabling the phone unregisters SIP but preserves the approved
  pairing.
- Single-instance startup prevents two RX Softphone processes from competing
  for the loopback control port. Starting it again opens the existing phone
  instead.
- Packaged web assets resolve from the executable directory, so the local
  control panel remains available when Windows Startup or another launcher
  uses a different working folder.

## Startup and compatibility

- `Start-Softphone.cmd` now launches the packaged application and exits
  immediately.
- The optional `--open` argument opens the local control panel after startup.
- Existing managed pairing and encrypted workstation state are retained during
  an in-place upgrade when the same Windows user profile and application folder
  are used.
- RX Tracker now requires managed workstation version 0.5.0 or later.

## Official Windows assets

- `server-update-4.0.0-next.11.zip` for the RX Tracker server;
- `RxSoftphone-0.5.0-win-x64.zip` for managed calling workstations;
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` covering both ZIPs and compiled executables.

## Database impact

None. This release adds no migration and changes no table, column, index,
constraint, patient record, RX record, call record, pairing, or credential.

Deploy through the standard staging, develop, and main promotion flow. Keep
the production `.env` unchanged and use Project Control option 15 only after
the release is approved.
